sender.zh: 打工App或臉書、IG、Threads上的徵才廣告：遠端打字、資料彙整、臨時觀眾、做公益領禮券
sender.en: Job ads in part-time job apps or on Facebook, Instagram or Threads: remote typing, data entry, paid audience, charity work for vouchers

name.zh: 假求職：輕鬆高薪打工，加LINE後要你繳保證金或「內部投資」
name.en: Fake part-time job: easy well-paid work, then a deposit or an “insider investment” on LINE

how.zh: 詐騙集團在打工App或社群刊登「在家賺錢、免經驗高薪」、遠端登打、臨時觀眾、配音員、活動體驗等徵才廣告，引導你加LINE聯繫。有的先真的發薪水一兩個月建立信任，再在工作群組推「限定投資專案」，群組裡有暗樁貼獲利，還安排假律師見證合約，要你用加密貨幣入金，出金前又要付三成「報酬」。有的則以報名費、保證金或騙取個資為目的。合法兼職不會要員工反過來投入資金。
how.en: Scammers post ads in job apps or on social media: “earn from home, no experience, high pay”, remote typing, paid audience, voice actor or event tester, and ask you to add a LINE account. Some really pay a salary for a month or two to gain trust, then promote a “limited investment project” in the work group, with fake colleagues posting profits and a fake lawyer witnessing a contract; you deposit crypto, then must pay a 30% “commission” before withdrawing. Others are after a registration fee, a deposit or your personal details. A real part-time job never asks staff to put money in.

text.zh: 看到輕鬆高薪的徵才廣告，被要求加LINE。
text.en: You see an easy, well-paid job ad and are asked to add LINE.

text.zh: 前期可能真的領到薪水，建立信任。
text.en: You may really get paid at first, building trust.

text.zh: 工作群組推出內部投資專案，或要你先繳保證金、報名費。
text.en: The work group pushes an insider investment, or you must pay a deposit or fee first.

text.zh: 想出金時要先付報酬或手續費，錢拿不回來。
text.en: To withdraw you must first pay a commission or fee, and the money is gone.

text.zh: 【徵臨時觀眾】免經驗，活動約3小時，會後領現金1700元，全台都有場次，有興趣請加LINE報名：[連結]
text.en: [Temporary audience wanted] No experience, about 3 hours, 1,700 cash after the event, sessions all over Taiwan. Add our LINE to sign up: [link]

text.zh: 各位同仁辛苦了！公司本月推出員工限定增資專案，名額只有二十位，投報率每月百分之十五，請有意願的同仁私訊主管登記。
text.en: Thanks for your hard work, everyone! This month the company has a staff-only capital increase project, just twenty places, returning fifteen percent a month. Message your manager privately to sign up.

zh: 在打工App找到遠端打字工作後被叫去投資
徵臨時觀眾的廣告要我加LINE繳保證金
工作群組推薦員工限定的投資專案
兼職公司要我用加密貨幣入金
出金前要先付三成報酬
在家工作的廣告要我先付報名費
en: i found a remote typing job on a job app and was then pushed to invest
an ad for paid audience members asked me to add line and pay a deposit
the work group recommended a staff only investment project
the part time company asked me to deposit crypto
i had to pay thirty percent commission before withdrawing
a work from home ad asked me to pay a registration fee first

zh: 免經驗、在家就能輕鬆領高薪
要你繳保證金、報名費，或投入資金、買加密貨幣
同事和主管在群組裡一直曬獲利
en: Easy high pay from home with no experience.
Interviews and contact happen only on LINE.
You must pay a deposit or fee, or invest or buy crypto.
Colleagues and managers keep posting profits in the group.

zh: 合法工作不會要你先付錢或投資；遇到就停止
應徵前查公司登記資料，不要只在LINE聯繫
有疑問打165；已經付款請報警
en: A real job never asks you to pay or invest first; stop if it does.
Check the company's registration before applying; don't deal only on LINE.
Call 165 if unsure; if you already paid, report it to the police.
